subject_toolchain_digest.description: Digest of the toolchain bundle under justification.

source_ref.description: Where the purported toolchain source came from.

trusted_compiler_digest.description: Digest of the diverse trusted compiler/toolchain used in DDC step 1.

step1_compiler_digest.description: Digest of compiler built from source using trusted compiler.

step2_compiler_digest.description: Digest of compiler built from source using the step1 compiler.

match.description: True iff step2 output equals the subject binary.

diffoscope_digest.description: Optional digest of a diff report if match=false.

assumptions.description: Optional list of assumptions for interpreting the result (e.g., trust in diverse compiler).
